span.p:
Product service has not
answered yet. Reconciled
automatically.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Stock is held, the Payment
service has not answered.
Retried until it does, or
until the time limit.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Ending without the goods
being used leaves a debt.
All three owe the stock back.
Expired and cancelled also
owe a void of the charge.
